Ozone can induce oxidative stress and inflammation in lung tissue, but its direct role in causing pulmonary fibrosis is less clear and not as well established as the other substances. Therefore, the most consensus-supported substances causing pulmonary fibrosis by inhalation are silica and bleomycin, with paraquat also being a significant contributor but less commonly recognized in this context compared to silica and bleomycin.
